items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: It was Octave's band... I went with Octave Crosby. I went to California. We worked out there for about five or six weeks.

ctx.x: Did you ever leave town with a band?
One time I went with Octave Crosby. I went to California. We worked out there for about five or six weeks. I went with him. That's the only time I ever went out of town with him.
